title: Speech by the Regional Commissioner of Mwanza during the opening of the seminar on the promotion of competition and combat of counterfeit goods for producers, held at the Mwanza City Council Hall in Mwanza on August 18, 2022.
title_sw: HOTUBA YA MHE. MKUU WA MKOA WA MWANZA WAKATI WA UFUNGUZI WA SEMINA YA UHAMASISHAJI WA MASUALA YA USHINDANI NA UDHIBITI WA BIDHAA BANDIA KWA WAZALISHAJI KATIKA UKUMBI WA HALMASHAURI YA JIJI LA MWANZA MKOANI MWANZA TAREHE 18 AGOSTI, 2022.
text:
HOTUBA YA MHE. MKUU WA MKOA WA MWANZA WAKATI WA
UFUNGUZI WA SEMINA YA UHAMASISHAJI WA MASUALA YA
USHINDANI NA UDHIBITI WA BIDHAA BANDIA KWA
WAZALISHAJI KATIKA UKUMBI WA HALMASHAURI YA JIJI LA
MWANZA MKOANI MWANZA TAREHE 18 AGOSTI, 2022.
Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa FCC,
Mkurugenzi wa Idara ya Kumlinda Mlaji,
Mkurugenzi wa Idara ya Udhibiti wa Bidhaa Bandia,
Mkurugenzi wa Idara ya Miungano ya Makampuni na Uraghibishi,
Mwakilishi wa CTI,
Wafanyakazi wa FCC,
Wawakilishi wa Sekretarieti ya Mkoa wa Mwanza,
Wawakilishi wa Halmashauri ya Jiji la Mwanza,
Wazalishaji,
Wanahabari,
Wageni waalikwa,
Mabibi na Mabwana.
Jamhuri ya Muungano!
Awali ya yote namshukuru Mwenyezi Mungu mwingi wa rehema na
fadhili kwa kutuwezesha kukutana katika shughuli hii tukiwa wazima
na wenye afya njema. Aidha, nitumie fursa hii kuwakaribisha sana
FCC, CTI na wageni wote mliotoka nje ya Mkoa wa Mwanza,
Karibuni sana!
1

Serikali ya Mkoa wa Mwanza ipo imara na tunawahakikishia Ulinzi na
Usalama pamoja na ushirikiano wa dhati katika shughuli za ujenzi wa
Taifa letu wakati wote mtakapokuwa hapa Mwanza.
Kipekee nitumie fursa hii pia kuishukuru na kuipongeza Serikali ya
awamu ya sita inayoongozwa na Mheshimiwa Samia Suluhu Hassan,
Rais wa Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania, kwa jitihada kubwa
inazozifanya katika kuwaletea maendeleo watanzania wote ikiwa ni
pamoja na kuongeza tija zaidi katika Sekta ya Viwanda na Biashara.
Aidha, nawapongeza sana FCC kwa utekelezaji wa majukumu yenu
kwa mujibu wa Sheria hususan katika masuala ya ushindani, udhibiti
wa bidhaa bandia na kumlinda Mlaji kwa ujumla. Haya ni masuala
muhimu sana, endapo tukishirikiana kwa dhati kuyasimamia vizuri na
kwa kuzingatia misingi ya Sheria, hapana shaka Sekta hii ya
uwekezaji, viwanda na biashara itastawi na itaongeza tija zaidi katika
nchi yetu.
Ndugu wanasemina, leo tumekusanyika mahali hapa kwa lengo kuu
la kupatiwa mafunzo ya Majukumu ya Tume ya Ushindani, Sheria ya
Ushindani, Udhibiti wa bidhaa bandia pamoja na wajibu wa
wazalishaji katika kumlinda mlaji. Nawashukuru sana FCC kwa kuona
umuhimu wa kutuletea semina hii katika Mkoa wetu wa Mwanza. Ni
dhahiri mmefanya uamuzi sahihi kutokana na Mkoa wetu kuwa na
shughuli nyingi za uzalishaji na uchumi pia.
Aidha, nawapongeza sana FCC kwa hatua mnazochukua katika
kufanya semina hizi kwa lengo la kuwafikia watanzania wengi zaidi,
lakini bado mna kazi ya ziada katika kuhakikisha mnafanya semina
2

nyingi zaidi ili watanzania wenzetu ambao wengi wao ni wakulima,
wafanyabiashara na wazalishaji pia wanapata Elimu hizi kikamilifu ili
kujiweka katika mazingira mazuri ya kiushindani kwa mujibu wa
taratibu na kanuni zilizopo. Serikali ya Mkoa wa Mwanza
tutashirikiana nanyi kama ambavyo Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa FCC
umebainisha.
Ndugu wanasemina, nimefarijika sana kuona muitikio wenu mzuri
ambapo ninyi ndio wazalishaji, na mna umuhimu mkubwa sana katika
mstakabali wa ukuaji wa uchumi kuanzia ngazi ya kaya hadi Taifa. Ili
muweze kustawi katika shughuli zenu hamna budi kuzingatia taratibu
za nchi na kuzingatia misingi ya ushindani. Hii ndio sababu ya FCC
kuona umuhimu wa kufanya semina hizi kwenu, hivyo, mna wajibu
wa kutumia fursa hii kwa umakini mkubwa ili baada ya mafunzo haya
tuone mabadiliko yatakayokuwa na tija katika shughuli zenu za
uzalishaji na katika ngazi ya Taifa kwa ujumla.
Wanufaika wa semina ya leo ni wazalishaji, hivyo nitoe rai kwa
taasisi, asasi na wananchi wengine wanaojishughulisha na masuala
ya ushindani kujenga utamaduni wa kutafuta Elimu kwa kina kutoka
FCC na Idara nyingine za Serikali ikiwa ni pamoja na Shirika la
Viwanda Vidogo (SIDO), Shirika la Viwango Tanzania (TBS), Wakala
wa Usajili na Leseni za Biashara (BRELA), na Wakala wa Vipimo
(WMA). Msingi wa kutoa rai hii ni kwasababu Taasisi hizi ikiwa ni
pamoja na FCC ni vyombo muhimu katika ustawi wa biashara na
usimamizi wa soko nchini Tanzania, na endapo Taasisi hizi
zikitumiwa ipasavyo ni dhahiri tija katika kuanzisha, kulea na kukuza
biashara zenu itakuwa kubwa na ya kuridhisha.
3

Hivyobasi, kupitia Semina hii natoa maelekezo kwa Wakurugenzi wa
Halmashauri zote katika Mkoa wa Mwanza kuhakikisha mnayabaini
makundi au vikundi ambavyo vinajihusisha na uzalishaji na
vinahudumiwa na Serikali kupitia Halmashauri zenu, hakikisheni
makundi hayo yanapata semina za namna hii ili kuongeza tija na
mnyororo wa thamani katika utekelezaji wa shughuli zao, na suala hili
litafanikiwa kwa kujenga ushirikiano wa kiutendaji na Taasisi hizo za
Serikali ikiwa ni pamoja na FCC ambayo kimsingi inafanya kazi nzuri
sana katika utoaji wa Elimu kwa wadau mbalimbali wa maendeleo na
Umma kwa ujumla, pia inafanya kazi vizuri ya udhibiti wa bidhaa
bandia nchini kwa kufanya kaguzi katika maeneo mbalimbali ya nchi
pamoja maingilio ya bidhaa. kwa kushirikiana na Taasisi hizi naamini
shughuli za uzalishaji mali na uchumi kwa wananchi wetu vijijini na
hata mijini utakuwa salama na wenye tija kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya
wananchi wetu.
Hivyo basi, Wakurugenzi wote wa Mamlaka za Serikali za Mitaa
katika Mkoa wa Mwanza hakikisheni mnakuwa na mpango kazi mzuri
utakaosaidia kuratibu mafunzo ya namna hii kwa ajili ya makundi yote
yanayonufaika na mikopo au fedha za Serikali zinazowagusa
wanawake, vijana na wenye ulemavu ambapo ni dhahiri
yatawajengea uwezo na weledi katika nyanja za uzalishaji, uuzaji,
ununuzi, utambuzi wa bidhaa bandia ikiwa ni pamoja na kujua misingi
bora ya ushindani wa soko na uchumi kwa ujumla. Aidha, utekelezaji
wa mpango kazi huo uzingatie kuzihusisha taasisi kama FCC katika
utoaji wa elimu.
4

Ndugu wanasemina, kupitia semina hii mtapokea mada mbalimbali
zitakazowajenga na kuwapa misingi muhimu juu ya biashara na
uchumi na mengine mengi yanayoakisi maendeleo katika shughuli
zenu za kila siku.
Hivyo ni vyema mkazingatia kwa makini fursa ya mafunzo haya ili
baada ya mafunzo haya tuone mabadiliko ikiwa ni pamoja na
kuzingatia maadili ya biashara ili kuhakikisha soko linabaki shindani,
bidhaa zinazopelekwa sokoni zinakidhi matarajio ya watumiaji au
wateja na taratibu za kupata faida zinazingatiwa na kuthamini utu wa
mtu, kuhakikisha mnawatendea haki wale mnaowapelekea bidhaa ili
wazinunue na kuzitumia ili kuendeleza uaminifu katika soko ikiwa ni
pamoja na kuwezesha upatikanaji wa ufanisi katika uchumi wa soko,
kujenga na kuimarisha mazingira sawa ya biashara katika soko baina
ya washindani, hayo yakifanikiwa bila shaka mtaweza kushindana
kwa vigezo vya ubora, bei, ubunifu na ufanisi.
Ndugu wanasemina, nimetaarifiwa kuwa kupitia semina hii pia
mtapata fursa ya kushauriana na kuelimishana kuhusu kuhusu kazi
za Tume hususan katika masuala mbalimbali yanayohusu udhibiti wa
bidhaa bandia, ni vyema pia mkaitumia fursa hii vizuri kwa
kuwasilisha kero na changamoto mbalimbali mnazokabiliana nazo
katika shughuli zenu kwa watendaji wa FCC ili ziweze kupatiwa
majawabu kikamilifu.
Aidha, pamoja na juhudi hizi, ni vyema pia mkafanya jitihada ya
kutafuta masoko kupitia Chama chenu kwa kuzitumia Taasisi
mbalimbali za ndani na nje kwa msaada wa Mamlaka ya Usimamizi
5

na Maendeleo ya Biashara nchini, TANTRADE ili muweze kukuza
biashara zenu.
Naamini, ninyi ambao leo mmepata fursa ya semina hii, Elimu
mtakayopata hapa mtakwenda kuwa mabalozi wazuri wa FCC
kwenda kuwaelimisha wananchi wengine ambao hawakupata fursa
ya kuhudhuria mafunzo haya.
Ndugu wanasemina, napenda kutumia fursa hii kwa niaba ya
Uongozi wa Serikali ya Mkoa wa Mwanza kuwashukuru tena FCC
kwa kutuletea mafunzo haya hapa Mwanza, nasi kama viongozi wa
Serikali na wananchi kwa ujumla tunawakaribisha tena wakati
wowote mtakaokuwa tayari kutuletea Elimu za namna hii zenye
maslahi mapana kwa wananchi wetu na Taifa kwa ujumla.
Baada ya kusema hayo, nawatakia Semina njema na sasa natamka
kuwa Semina hii imefunguliwa rasmi.
Asanteni sana kwa kunisikiliza!
Speech by the Regional Commissioner of Mwanza during the
opening of the seminar on the promotion of competition and combat
of counterfeit goods for producers, held at the Mwanza City Council
Hall in Mwanza on August 18, 2022.
Director-General of FCC,
Director of the Consumer Protection Department,
6

Director of Anti-Counterfeits Department,
Director of Research, Mergers and Advocacy Department,
Representative of CTI,
FCC Staff,
Representatives of the Mwanza Regional Secretariat,
Representatives of the Mwanza City Council,
Producers,
Journalists,
Invited guests,
Ladies and Gentlemen.
United Republic of Tanzania!
First of all, I thank Almighty God, full of mercy and grace, for enabling
us to gather for this event in good health. Additionally, I would like to
warmly welcome FCC, CTI, and all guests from outside the Mwanza
Region. You are most welcome!
The government of the Mwanza Region is strong, and we assure you
of security, safety, and sincere cooperation in our nation-building
efforts while you are here in Mwanza.
7

I use this opportunity to express gratitude and commend the sixth-
phase government led by Her Excellency Samia Suluhu Hassan, the
President of the United Republic of Tanzania, for the significant
efforts made in bringing development to all Tanzanians, including
enhancing productivity in the sectors of Industry and Trade.
Furthermore, I commend FCC for executing its responsibilities
according to the law, especially in matters of competition, combat of
counterfeit goods, and overall consumer protection. These are crucial
issues, and if we collaborate earnestly to manage them well and
adhere to the principles of the law, undoubtedly, the investment,
industry, and business sectors will thrive and contribute more to our
country's development.
Dear participants, today we have gathered here with the main
objective of receiving training on the responsibilities of the Fair
Competition Commission, competition law, combat of counterfeit
goods, and the role of producers in protecting consumers. I thank
FCC for recognizing the importance of this seminar to our region. For
sure you have made the right decision, given that our region is
involved in various production and economic activities.
8

I also commend FCC for the steps you are taking to conduct these
seminars with the aim of reaching more Tanzanians. However, there
is still extra work to be done to ensure that more seminars are
conducted so that our fellow Tanzanians, many of whom are farmers,
traders, and producers, can fully benefit from this education to
position themselves competitively in accordance with the existing
regulations and principles. The Mwanza Regional Government will
collaborate with you, as stated by the Director-General of the FCC.
Dear seminar participants, I am delighted to see your positive
response, as you, being the producers, play a crucial role in ensuring
the welfare of our households and the overall national economy. To
prosper in your activities, you must adhere to the country's
regulations and embrace the principles of competition. This is why
FCC finds it crucial to conduct these seminars for you. Thus, you
have a responsibility to make good use of this opportunity to ensure
that, after this training, we witness positive changes that will benefit
your production activities, their efficiency, and the overall economic
growth of our Mwanza Region and the nation as a whole.
I expect that today's seminar will be beneficial. Therefore, I urge
institutions, organizations, and other citizens involved in competition
issues to cultivate a culture of seeking in-depth education from FCC
and other government departments, including the Small Industries
Development Organization (SIDO), Tanzania Bureau of Standards
9

(TBS), Business Registrations and Licensing Agency (BRELA), and
Weights and Measures Agency (WMA). I emphasize this
recommendation because these institutions, including FCC, are
crucial bodies for the prosperity of business and market oversight in
Tanzania. If these institutions are utilized appropriately, it is clear that
the success in establishing, nurturing, and growing your businesses
will be significant and satisfying.
Therefore, through this seminar, I give instructions to all Directors of
Local Government Authorities in the Mwanza Region to ensure that
you identify groups or associations involved in various production
activities in our region, which are served by the government through
your respective local authorities. Make sure these groups receive
seminars like this to enhance efficiency and value chain in their
activities. This goal will be achieved by establishing a functional
collaboration with these government institutions, including the FCC,
which fundamentally does an excellent job in providing education to
various development stakeholders and the public at large. It also
effectively controls counterfeit goods in the country by conducting
inspections in various regions and entry points.
Thus, all Directors of Local Government Authorities in the Mwanza
Region, ensure that you have a good action plan to coordinate such
training for all groups benefiting from government loans or funds that
touch on women, youth, and people with disabilities. These groups
10

will build capacity and expertise in the fields of production, sales,
purchase, identification of counterfeit goods, and understanding the
best principles of market competition and the economy as a whole.
Additionally, the implementation of this action plan should involve
institutions such as the FCC in providing education.
Dear seminar participants, through this seminar, you will receive
various topics that will build and provide essential foundations for
your daily business and economic activities and many other aspects
that reflect development. Therefore, pay careful attention to the
training opportunities so that, after this training, we can see positive
changes, including maintaining business ethics to ensure a
competitive market. The products you bring to the market must meet
the expectations of consumers, and procedures for profit must be
adhered to, valuing human dignity. Ensure that you treat those to
whom you deliver products fairly, encouraging them to purchase and
use them to maintain trust in the market. This includes facilitating the
achievement of efficiency in the market economy, building and
enhancing a level playing field in the market among competitors. If
successful, undoubtedly, you will be able to compete based on
quality, price, innovation, and efficiency.
Dear seminar participants, I have been informed that through this
seminar, you will also have the opportunity to consult and educate
each other on the functions of the Commission, especially in various
11

issues related to the control of counterfeit goods. It is advisable to
use this opportunity well by presenting challenges and issues you
face in your activities to FCC executives so that they can provide
comprehensive and effective solutions.
Moreover, despite these efforts, it is essential to make an effort to
seek markets through your associations by utilizing various internal
and external institutions with the support of the Tanzania Trade
Development Authority to grow your businesses.
I believe that you, as producers, who have the opportunity to attend
this seminar, will become good ambassadors of the FCC to educate
other citizens who did not have the chance to attend this training.
Dear seminar participants, on behalf of the Mwanza Regional
Government, I would like to express our gratitude to the FCC for
bringing this training to Mwanza. We, as leaders of the government
and the people at large, welcome you anytime you are ready to bring
education that has broad benefits to our citizens and the nation as a
whole.
Furthermore, tomorrow, on August 19, 2022, the national population
and housing census will officially begin. I believe that every
12

Tanzanian and Mwanza resident has received accurate information
and education about participating in the census. Therefore, I take this
opportunity to urge all residents of the Mwanza Region to be ready to
be counted and provide the required information accurately and give
full cooperation to the census enumerators when they come to your
areas.
After saying that, I wish you
a successful seminar, and I now declare this seminar officially open.
Thank you very much for listening!
13
